host_interface: framework-neutral tool objects { name, description, inputSchema, execute } and before/after hooks
level_note: Identity is the client's credentials and readers are enforced by the gateway, so governed recall holds for what the tools expose. The tools cannot set readers, ids or derivations, so checks that need those are run against the client or the gateway directly.

not_exercised.known-at: recall exposes as_of but not known_at
not_exercised.acl: readers come from config (audience), not from the model
not_exercised.removal-equivalence: needs explicit readers on setup writes
